spanish: Porque si rehúsante tú de enviar, y todavía tú aferrado en ellos,

findings.issue: Hiphil active participle is rendered as the passive participle aferrado, so the 2ms subject is the one gripped rather than the one holding.

notes: כי אם, the piel participle with אתה, ל plus the piel infinitive, and עודך plus בם are otherwise represented.
